# Requests and replies (docs/requests.md): byte for byte, every binding
# reproduces them (README.md). Run by the suite's runner and core's run_protocol.c.
#
# A case is a line "request <name>", then:
#   setup <name>      the host it runs on (README.md, "Setups"; default empty)
#   send <hex>        a request, as CBOR
#   reply <hex>       the reply it gets; "reply none": no reply (a notification)
#   capacity <n>      the next send is first given n bytes: TA_ERROR_NO_MEMORY
#                     with the length it needs, then that length: the reply
#                     (and what the refused one did not apply)
#   diag <text>       the hex line before it, in diagnostic notation
# A case's sends go in order to one host. In a reply, 39999("<type>") is a
# wildcard (README.md); an error's message always is one.

request not CBOR
send ff
diag (not CBOR)
reply a2626964f6656572726f72a364636f6465397fbb676d657373616765d99c3f64746578746464617461a266726561736f6e696d616c666f726d6564647061746860
diag {"id":null,"error":{"code":-32700,"message":39999("text"),"data":{"reason":"malformed","path":""}}}
